schedule.title: Timetable Schedule
schedule.description: Represents a published or saved weekly timetable schedule containing all events and grid settings.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this schedule

ownerEmail.description: The email of the schedule owner

config.description: Grid display and sizing configuration parameters

events.description: A list of course/activity events currently pinned in this timetable

user.title: User Profile
user.description: Stores profile and utility usage limits such as AI Intelligent Scheduler credits.

ownerEmail.description: The email address of the user

aiCredits.description: Number of remaining AI scheduler credits

/schedules/{scheduleId}.description: Stores shared timetables published by users, searchable by the unique schedule ID.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile metadata tracking AI credits.
